description: After-sales support profile of one robot, for a buyer in Europe: warranty duration, start and exclusions, spare parts with dated offers (seller, price in original currency, availability, lead time), maintenance required of the operator, software updates and subscriptions, service in Europe, lifecycle, and the open questions to ask before signing. Every fact carries who states it, its evidence level, a verbatim quote and its source; unknowns are listed as unknown with their search date. Requires an access right on the robot requested; without it the call returns a refusal naming that robot.
name: get_robot_support
title: After-sales support profile
